target_customer: Indonesian employers hiring blue-collar workers, later businesses buying AI plus human-in-the-loop automation
problem: Underserved blue-collar workers in Southeast Asia lacked a job community; employers needed to reach them at scale. The company later shifted to automating repetitive operations with AI plus human review.
business_model: Job marketplace and community, later prepaid usage-based AI plus human automation service (from USD 13 per hour AI, USD 2 to 6 per hour human)
product_category: Blue-collar job platform, later AI plus human workflow automation

founders.name: Aswin Andrison
education: UNSW, computer science and chemical engineering degree
MBA, London Business School and MIT
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; TechNode describes over 16 years in FMCG, grocery and MSME markets.

founders.name: Tri Ahmad Irfan
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CTO by TechNode, January 2022. YC page lists only Andrison.

competitors.name: MyRobin
competitors.what: Startup serving blue-collar gig and job needs in Indonesia

competitors.name: Sampingan
competitors.what: Blue-collar work platform named in one version of the DailySocial article (another version lists Side)

competitors.name: Workmate
competitors.what: Startup serving blue-collar jobs, named in DailySocial coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: A job listing and community platform is standard engineering; the company claimed about 3,000 new jobs and 1,000 sign-ups a day within two months, which implies simple aggregation work.

defensibility.rationale: Worker and employer network could build liquidity, but job boards are easy to copy and the competitors named already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; the company itself moved away from recruiting toward automation.

market_need_then: Indonesia has a very large blue-collar workforce; the company cited a target of 80 to 120 million workers and reported over 100,000 job seekers and 20,000 jobs within two months of launch.

branding.name_origin: Per TechNode, from the word for light: the founders wanted to be the light for underserved workers when other lights go out.
branding.domain_note: Product now sits at lumibot.com under the Lumibot name; earlier domain not found.

rebrands.why: Expansion from a job platform to an AI plus human automation service, per the YC page; date not stated

branding.community_and_virality: Positioned as a job community; the company claims a network of 1.5 million workers, a figure from its own YC profile.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word shared with many unrelated Lumina brands; no press on the brand itself, and the name was split by the Lumibot pivot.

pivots.to: Lumibot, AI plus human-in-the-loop automation for operations and data work
pivots.why: Global expansion beyond recruiting per the YC page; exact date not stated

pivots.from: Broad AI plus human workflow automation
pivots.to: Video AI hand-tracking copilot for manual manufacturing (current lumibot.com)
pivots.why: Not stated by company; described in a secondary profile and the current site

outcome_analysis: Lumina launched as an Indonesian blue-collar job community, reported fast early traction, and took a YC and Alpha JWC investment in January 2022 with an undisclosed amount. It later pivoted to Lumibot automation and then to manufacturing video AI, so the original job platform story did not become the lasting business. It remains active with a team of 12; whether the pivot succeeded is not yet visible in public data.
notes: Amount of the January 2022 round was not disclosed; aggregators give $0.5M, $4.5M and $15M and are unverified. The YC page lists Monk's Hill, Goodwater, SWC Global and January Capital as backers, with no dates, so they are not recorded as a round. Lumina is described as Jakarta-based in 2022 coverage and Singapore-based on YC. Competitor list differs between two versions of the DailySocial article (Side vs Sampingan). Traction of 1.5 million workers is company-claimed. Seedtable, Crunchbase and CB Insights entries were not opened.
